name: warehouse_resupply
source_sql: SELECT w.id, w.code, w.company_id, (SELECT count(*) FROM stock_wh_resupply_table r WHERE r.supplied_wh_id = w.id) AS n_resupply FROM stock_warehouse w

name: internal_locations_by_warehouse
source_sql: SELECT warehouse_id, count(*) AS n FROM stock_location WHERE usage = 'internal' AND active GROUP BY warehouse_id

name: picking_types_per_code
source_sql: SELECT id, code, sequence, warehouse_id, (SELECT count(*) FROM picking_type_favorite_user_rel f WHERE f.picking_type_id = t.id) AS n_favorites FROM stock_picking_type t WHERE active

name: pull_rules_per_route
source_sql: SELECT route_id, action, count(*) AS n FROM stock_rule WHERE active GROUP BY route_id, action

name: orderpoint_bounds
source_sql: SELECT id, product_id, location_id, trigger, product_min_qty, product_max_qty FROM stock_warehouse_orderpoint
